summary: Feed s162_triple is degraded for NDR: 6.8% TCP packet loss, VLAN 20 completely missing (49% untagged), and 92.7% encrypted traffic above 90% tolerance. NDR will miss reassembled flows, blind to VLAN 20 segment, and limited to metadata-only detection.

findings.root_cause: Required VLAN 20 never appears and 49% of packets arrive untagged - packet broker or SPAN/TAP trunk is stripping 802.1Q tags or forwarding only native VLAN. Likely broker egress set to 'strip tags' or SPAN trunk not configured to forward VLANs 10 and 20.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR has zero visibility into VLAN 20 segment and cannot apply VLAN-aware policies; misses lateral movement and segmentation violations, 50% coverage gap for required VLANs.

params.verify_trunk: allow VLANs 10,20 on TAP/SPAN and broker ingress

recommended_fix.why: Restore 802.1Q tags end-to-end so NDR receives both required VLANs 10 and 20 for complete segmentation-aware detection.

findings.root_cause: 6.8% of TCP packets (186/2716) show gaps/retransmissions indicating upstream loss, not tool overload (tool ingress healthy). Classic SPAN oversubscription/buffer exhaustion or packet broker egress congestion dropping packets before NDR.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR cannot reliably reassemble TCP streams - 6.8% missing data causes broken flows, missed signatures, failed file extraction and increased false negatives; needs full payload and both directions.

recommended_fix.why: TAPs do not drop under load like SPAN; eliminates buffer drops and restores complete TCP streams for NDR reassembly and detection.

findings.root_cause: 92.75% of bytes are encrypted, exceeding NDR's 90% tolerance. Traffic is predominantly TLS 1.2/1.3 with no decryption in path, so NDR sees only handshakes/metadata.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR is blind to payload - cannot do deep packet inspection, JA3, file extraction or C2 detection on 93% of traffic; detection reduced to flow metadata and anomalies only.

params.method: out-of-band SSL visibility with key sharing or passive decryption
params.policy: decrypt selectively or forward keys to NDR

recommended_fix.why: Provide cleartext to NDR where policy allows; without decryption NDR cannot inspect 93% encrypted payload despite needing full payload.
